name: Interstate Power Systems
old_description: Interstate Power Systems have been a leading distributor of both on- and off-highway engines and transmissions since 1957. We also provide extensive parts and service for vocational trucks and heavy equipment. And we’ve got all your power generation, marine, transport refrigeration and OEM needs covered.
about:
Founded in 1957 as Interstate – GM Diesel in Minneapolis, Minnesota, the company began as one of the first distributors for Detroit Diesel and Allison Transmission. Now operating as Interstate Power Systems, the business is headquartered in Gillette, Wyoming, and maintains a network of locations across twelve Midwestern and Western states.

The company distributes on-highway and off-highway engines and transmissions and provides a full range of support services. Its Gillette facility offers generator sales and service, contract maintenance, electrical load bank testing, electric motor and radiator repair, crane and construction equipment repair, and mining equipment assembly and disassembly. Technicians also handle transport refrigeration, light utility vehicles, and dielectric testing, with 24/7 emergency response available.

Interstate serves customers in oil and gas, mining, construction, industrial manufacturing, transportation, power generation, and marine sectors. Vocational truck fleets, heavy equipment operators, and mining operations rely on its OEM parts inventory and field service crews to minimize downtime.

The company emphasizes its experienced, OEM-trained technicians, extensive parts stock, and a connected network of Interstate Companies divisions that share technical expertise and resources. This structure allows coordinated, end-to-end support from the shop floor to remote job sites.
